description: Goal evaluator vectors (plan §5.5). Each case gives the goal set, the subject and its events; an evaluator must produce exactly expect.outcomes, in this order, and expect.disabled. expect.progress, where present, is the state the evaluation ends in. The format and every rule are in README.md beside this file. The PHP suite (tests/Goals/GoalVectorsTest.php) runs every case; the Swift (PR 8) and Kotlin (PR 7) suites are to read this same file.

cases.name: the first matching event reaches a count-1 goal
cases.why: count keeps counting matching events after the goal is reached; repeat once stops further outcomes

cases.name: event names match exactly, case included
eq compares strings byte for byte
numbers compare by value; a string never equals a number
neq needs the property to be present
comparators take numbers only, and predicates are ANDed
gte and lt
in matches any listed value with the same typed equality
bools equal bools only; exists is true for any present value
$revenue is the event's own revenue field in a predicate
cases.why: a property named revenue is not the revenue field

cases.name: an install trigger never matches on a click
cases.why: an event NAMED install is an ordinary event; only the install itself matches the install trigger

cases.name: count N reaches on the N-th matching event
repeat each with a count reaches every N-th, up to max
every renewal, capped at 3, paid from revenue
a sum threshold reaches when the running sum crosses it
one event can reach several n when a sum jumps
an event whose summed property is missing or not a number is not counted
sums are exact in units of 0.00001
cases.why: 0.1 + 0.2 in binary floating point is not 0.3; in units it is

cases.name: after: events before the prerequisite is reached do not count
after: a prerequisite reached by the same event counts, in after order not id order
after: order is event time, not arrival
cases.why: the tutorial arrived first, but it happened after the registration

cases.name: after: an ineligible prerequisite does not satisfy
a window counts from its anchor, start included, end excluded
a window whose anchor the subject lacks makes the outcome ineligible, never re-based
the effective time is the earlier of occurred_at and received_at
cases.why: a clock that says 5000 for an event the server received at 2000 is clamped to 2000

cases.name: ties sort by received_at, then by event id bytes
a late earlier purchase re-decides which purchase is which n
cases.why: the plan's $5, $10, late $1 case: the answer is $1, $5, $10 whatever the arrival order

cases.name: each event is evaluated under the version current when it was received
cases.why: versions keep separate progress: an edit starts the goal afresh

cases.name: a version is chosen by received_at, not by the event's own clock
a rebase evaluates every event under at least the rebased version
a rebase also covers events received before the goal existed
no version is effective yet: the event is not evaluated under the goal
a goal evaluates arrivals in [starts_at, ends_at)
cases.why: starts_at is when a campaign attached the goal; ends_at is when it was archived

cases.name: an invalid definition disables that goal only
an unknown field makes a definition invalid
a prerequisite outside the set disables the goal
goals whose after forms a cycle are disabled; the others evaluate
from_property reads the named property and says why it could not
cases.why: an unreadable value still reaches the goal: it is recorded with its note, not dropped

cases.name: value none is tracked with no value
an install subject: the install itself, windows from install, and no click
an install subject with a click can evaluate a click window
